units.source_text: 渐渐到了秋季，天色清幽，催人感慨。

en.t: Gradually autumn arrived, and the clear, quiet sky stirred feelings of reflection.

units.source_text: 附近的田里正在刈稻，许多青年女子依照当地农家姑娘的习惯，高声唱歌，欢笑自得。

en.t: In the nearby fields, rice was being harvested, and many young women, following the custom of local farm girls, sang loudly and laughed with carefree delight.

units.source_text: 驱鸟板的鸣声也很有趣味。

en.t: The clattering sound of the bird-scaring boards was also quite charming.

units.source_text: 这使得浮舟回忆起当年住在常陆国时的情景。

en.t: This made Ukifune remember the scenes from the years when she had lived in Hitachi Province.

units.source_text: 这地方比夕雾左大臣家落叶公主的母亲所居的山乡更进深一些，

en.t: This place lay somewhat deeper in the mountains than the rural retreat where the mother of Princess Ochiba, of Yugiri the Left Minister's household, lived,

units.source_text: 所以松树非常繁茂，起风的时候，松涛之声异常凄凉。

en.t: so the pine trees grew very thickly, and when the wind rose, the sound of the pines was extraordinarily desolate.

units.source_text: 浮舟空闲无事，每日只是诵经念佛，悄然度送岁月。

en.t: With nothing to occupy her, Ukifune spent each day simply chanting sutras and reciting the Buddha's name, quietly letting the months and years pass.

units.source_text: 月明之夜，妹尼僧亦常弹琴作乐。

en.t: On moonlit nights, the younger nun would often play the koto and make music as well.

units.source_text: 她的徒弟名叫少将的小尼僧弹琵琶，和她合奏。

en.t: Her disciple, a young nun named Shojo, played the biwa and performed together with her.

units.source_text: 她对浮舟说：“你也玩音乐么？

en.t: She said to Ukifune, "Do you also play music?

units.source_text: 空闲无事的时候，玩玩也好。”

en.t: When you have leisure and nothing else to do, it is good to play a little."

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“我从小命苦，不曾享过玩弄弦管的清福。

en.t: Ukifune thought, "I have had a hard fate since childhood and have never enjoyed the refined blessing of playing strings and pipes.

units.source_text: 自幼以至成人，一向不识风雅之趣，实甚可怜！”

en.t: From childhood until adulthood, I have never known the pleasures of elegance and taste; it is truly pitiful!"

units.source_text: 她每次看见这些年事已长的妇人玩弄丝竹排遣寂寥，

en.t: Whenever she saw these older women playing music on strings and flutes to dispel their loneliness,

units.source_text: 总是不胜感慨，觉得此身实在毫无意趣，自己亦深为怜惜。

en.t: she was always overcome with emotion, feeling that her own life had no charm at all, and she deeply pitied herself.

units.source_text: 习字的时候便写诗一首：

en.t: While practicing calligraphy, she then wrote a poem:
